name: import-export
title: Import Export
description: Application UI pattern: ImportDialog brings a CSV (or Excel, with your own reader) into a list in three steps in a Modal: upload with the File Uploader, map each column to a field, review every row with its problems beside it and import the rows without any, ending on the result with the skipped rows to download. ExportDialog takes rows out: which rows, which columns (Column Chooser) and, when there is a choice, which format. Ships parseCsv, toCsv (formula-safe) and downloadCsv.
